Type: rug
Name: Rivet Motion Modern Patterned Wool Runner Rug, 2' 3" x 7' 6", Denim Blue
Colors: Denim Blue
Materials: Wool Pile
100% Wool Imported A striking design features chic simplicity, flat weave, and beautiful shades of denim blue. Each rug is hand woven for texture and superior durability, with stylish depth and dimension. 2'3" x 7'6" Hand-tufted in India High pile height is provides extra comfort Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
